dimensions.assessment: Affects manufacturers, distributors, and users of walk-in coolers and freezers, but exact numbers are not provided.
Relieves certain industries from complying with upcoming energy conservation standards.
dimensions.evidence: walk-in non-display doors and walk-in refrigeration systems are no longer required to comply with the new standards

dimensions.assessment: The source text does not mention specific dollar amounts for federal spending or economic impact.
Nullifies a single specific Department of Energy rule concerning walk-in coolers and freezers.
dimensions.evidence: disapproves the rule submitted by the Department of Energy... and such rule shall have no force or effect

dimensions.assessment: Permanently invalidates the specified Department of Energy rule.

importance_detail.rationale: Eliminates new energy conservation standards for walk-in coolers and freezers adopted by the Department of Energy, removing compliance requirements for non-display doors and refrigeration systems.
